output.summary: The record FY2026 result is mostly a commodity price rally. Revenue rose 46.5% on flat bushels, and the cooperative ranked 8th of 23 on revenue growth and 10th of 23 on net savings growth, so the Operational Excellence program is not shown to be the driver. The 6% cost-per-bushel gain comes from a one-third cut in maintenance spending while deferred work orders tripled. Harlan Junction has real dust and ignition hazards, an uninvestigated near-miss and an insurer deadline of 21 November. Drying and grading depend on one retiring superintendent with no documented procedures. The expansion case assumes FY2026 prices and unsourced throughput, and its staffing and maintenance sections are blank. Fix the hazards and capture the knowledge now, and defer the vote until the case is rebuilt on normalized prices.
